name: gru-minion
description: The Gru/minion two-tier agent architecture, packaged for Claude Code.

plugins.name: gru-minion
plugins.description: Work as the planning role in a two-tier agent architecture: delegate bounded, contract-shaped, high-volume work to a cheaper model, and verify every result by re-running real checks rather than trusting the report. Needs an OPENROUTER_API_KEY; the executor runs via uvx with no install step.
